chunks: 1086 - He said: I asked him about a slave woman, when she gives birth, whether the khimar is upon her.
He said: "If it were required for her, then it would be required for her when she menstruates; but covering the head in salat (prayer) is not required for her."
ai.seo_question: Is a slave woman required to wear a khimar in salat (prayer) after giving birth?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the dress of a slave woman in salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام states that head-covering is not required for her in prayer, arguing that if it were obligatory, it would have become obligatory from the time of menstruation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1086 - I asked him about a slave woman (amā) who gave birth, and whether the headcover (khimar) would be required for her.
Imam (as) said: "If it were required for her, She would have to wear it when She menstruates, but there is no requirement for her to wear a headcover in prayer."
